articles.summary: Underground marketplaces supply a range of services in need for the novice fraudster – server infrastructure, targeted lists, and even support for money laundering facilitated through compromised accounts. This blog post undertakes an exploration of these marketplaces and their operational modalities, illuminating the contemporary fraud economy and underscoring the enduring critical nature of robust detection and prevention initiatives.
articles.title: The Fraud Ecosystem: A Transition From Known Marketplaces to a Fragmented Environment

articles.summary: Newly exploited vulnerabilities jumped from 8% to 40% in Q2 2026, outpacing traditional patch cycles
articles.title: Rapid7 Finds Nearly Two-Thirds of Vulnerabilities Exploited in Q2 2026 Required No User Interaction to Initiate

articles.summary: If your VM scan engine already holds credentials for a host, it can ask that host which ports are open instead of probing for them. The engine connects to the port that credential uses, authenticates with a credential you already manage, and the host's operating system returns an authoritative list of the ports it is listening on – no probing, no inference, and nothing to wait out.
articles.title: Credentialed Pre-Port Discovery: Don't Probe the Host, Ask it

articles.summary: On September 1, 2026, SonicWall disclosed two vulnerabilities affecting SonicWall SMA1000 appliances that the vendor says are being actively exploited in the wild. The vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-83548 and CVE-2026-83549, can be chained to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE) on affected appliances.
articles.title: Critical SonicWall SMA1000 Vulnerabilities CVE-2026-83548, CVE-2026-83549 Exploited in the Wild

articles.summary: On September 22, 2026, F5 published a security advisory for CVE-2026-94127, a critical heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability affecting F5 BIG-IP Access Policy Manager (APM). The vulnerability has a CVSS v3.1 score of 9.8. An unauthenticated attacker with network access to an affected virtual server may be able to achieve remote code execution (RCE) by sending specifically crafted traffic.
articles.title: CVE-2026-94127: Critical Unauthenticated RCE in F5 BIG-IP APM

articles.summary: Another banger from Metasploit with sixteen new modules, including ten exploit modules, with five on the CISA KEV list. Cisco, Papercut, Sonicwall, Jetbrains, and Langflow all have exploit modules, and not to be outdone, we even have a Metasploit scanner to watch the watchers!
articles.title: Metasploit Wrap Up: This One Goes to Sixteen!

articles.summary: GitLab has patched CVE-2026-85706, a CVSSv3.1 10.0 path traversal vulnerability in the repository commits API that allows an unauthenticated user to read arbitrary files from GitLab CE and EE servers. CISA added the vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on September 11, 2026. Self-managed instances should be upgraded to 19.1.8, 19.2.6, or 19.3.2 on an emergency basis.
articles.title: CVE-2026-85706: Critical GitLab Path Traversal Exploited in the Wild

articles.summary: For anyone evaluating MDR right now, The Managed Detection and Response Services Landscape, Q3 2026 report by Forrester is a useful map that lays out where the market is heading. Rapid7 was named among the notable providers in this Forrester MDR Landscape, and while being included matters to us, the more interesting story is in what Forrester says about the market itself.
articles.title: Rapid7 Named Among Notable Vendors in Forrester MDR Landscape: Why the Future is Exposure-informed, Preemptive MDR

articles.summary: While conducting research into a recent N-able N-central authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-18577), Rapid7 Labs discovered two new vulnerabilities affecting the latest version of N-central. When chained together, these two vulnerabilities allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication and create a new attacker-controlled System administrator account on an affected server.
articles.title: CVE-2026-86206, CVE-2026-86207: N-able N-central Authentication Bypass (FIXED)

articles.summary: A new Linux toolkit, identified by Rapid7 Labs, has been targeting organizations across South Korea’s automotive and media industries with minimal detection. This previously undocumented framework, enabled threat actors to execute remote commands on compromised servers, inject malicious scripts into web traffic, perform credential harvesting, and engage in long-term surveillance.
articles.title: DPRK APTs: Ted backdoor and curlRAT target South Korean media and automotive sectors

articles.summary: On September 14, 2026, Cisco published a security advisory for CVE-2026-76461, a critical SQL injection vulnerability affecting Cisco AsyncOS Software for Cisco Secure Email Gateway. The vulnerability has a reported CVSS v3.1 base score of 9.8 and could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on an affected appliance.
articles.title: CVE-2026-76461: Critical Cisco Secure Email Gateway Vulnerability Exploited in the Wild

articles.summary: Microsoft is publishing 974 own-product vulnerabilities on September 2026 Patch Tuesday, including 723 vulnerabilities in Windows. This is by far the most CVEs that Microsoft has ever published in a single day.
articles.title: Patch Tuesday - September 2026
